newsitem.title: JAPAN: Woodland higher on reported software deal.
newsitem.headline: Woodland higher on reported software deal.

text.p: Shares in Woodland Corp rose in over-the-counter (OTC) trading on Wednesday morning after a newspaper report that the computer software maker will provide NEC Corp with sales management software for small- and medium-sized companies.
The share price was up 120 yen at 3,810 yen at midday. Volume was 58,000 shares.

The industrial daily Nikkei Sangyo Shimbun said that, under the deal, NEC would sell the software under its own brand name. The report also said Woodland hoped to double its sales of the software in the next business year from annual sales of 1,000 units currently.
Woodland officials were not immediately available for comment.
